function: NIST's aes-sbox-sel: inputs c x0..x7, outputs y0..y7; the AES S-box (FIPS 197) for c = 0 and its inverse for c = 1 (x0, y0 the most significant bits)

problems: note: 1 NOT gates counted as gates and depth levels

bit_order: inputs c x0..x7 and outputs y0..y7 in that order, c and x0, y0 the most significant (msb/msb), as in NIST's aes-sbox-sel files

nist.compared_with: every aes-sbox-sel circuit of the pin (9): aes-sbox-sel/
nist.pareto_points_note: NIST's Pareto points in (A, AD, G, GD) among the 9 (9 points) that this circuit matches or beats in all four and beats in at least one

checker: circuits/check.py (boolcirc) as at this commit; BoolFlux core and independent/verify.py as at commit 2c949cb, each with its own FIPS-197 tables, on all 512 inputs (the checks of aes_check.py), and NIST's 9 aes-sbox-sel circuits; and a third evaluator (the table computed from GF(2^8) and the affine map of FIPS 197, written for this check)
